theme.en: AI Demand Reorders Chips, Memory, and Models
theme.zh: AI需求重排芯片、存储与模型版图

dek.en: Nvidia reaches into the model ecosystem while HBM4 base dies absorb Samsung's 4nm capacity and TSMC's 3nm output value overtakes 5nm. AI demand is now reshaping ownership, foundry allocation, and memory pricing at the same time.
dek.zh: Nvidia将触角伸向模型生态，HBM4基础裸片占用Samsung的4nm产能，而TSMC 3nm产值首次超过5nm。AI需求正同时重塑产业所有权、晶圆代工产能分配与存储价格。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Acquires Hugging Face for $12.9 Billion
title.zh: Nvidia以129亿美元收购Hugging Face

summary.en: Nvidia is acquiring open-source model hub Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, according to EE Times. The deal would extend Nvidia beyond compute hardware into a distribution and collaboration layer used across the AI software ecosystem, tightening its connection to developers and model deployment.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，Nvidia将以129亿美元收购开源模型平台Hugging Face。此举将Nvidia的版图从计算硬件延伸到AI软件生态广泛使用的模型分发与协作层，并强化其与开发者及模型部署流程的连接。

title.en: Dell Sees AI Driving 75% of Datacenter Demand by 2030
title.zh: Dell预计2030年AI将贡献75%的数据中心需求

summary.en: Dell projects that AI will account for 75% of datacenter demand by 2030. The forecast signals that servers, accelerators, networking, and power infrastructure are converging around AI workloads, but it remains a long-range vendor estimate rather than booked demand.
summary.zh: Dell预计，到2030年AI将占数据中心需求的75%。这一预测表明服务器、加速器、网络与供电基础设施正围绕AI工作负载汇聚，但它仍是厂商的长期估算，并非已经锁定的订单。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC's 3nm Output Value Is Set to Overtake 5nm
title.zh: TSMC 3nm产值将首次超过5nm

summary.en: TSMC's 3nm quarterly output value is estimated to exceed NT$400 billion in the third quarter, surpassing 5nm for the first time. The crossover indicates that the newest leading-edge node is becoming the foundry's primary value engine, even though output value is not the same as wafer volume or unit shipments.
summary.zh: TSMC第三季度3nm产值预计将超过新台币4,000亿元，并首次超越5nm。这一交叉点表明最新先进制程正在成为其主要产值引擎，但产值并不等同于晶圆投片量或芯片出货量。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: HBM4 Base Dies Consume Up to 60% of Samsung's 4nm Output
title.zh: HBM4基础裸片占Samsung 4nm产出的比例最高达60%

summary.en: Samsung has reportedly allocated more than half—and as much as 60%—of its 4nm foundry output to HBM4 base dies as memory demand outruns supply. Because the base die uses a logic process rather than the DRAM process used for the stacked memory layers, HBM4 is now competing directly for leading-edge foundry capacity.
summary.zh: 据报道，随着HBM需求超过供给，Samsung已将超过一半、最高达60%的4nm晶圆代工产出分配给HBM4基础裸片。基础裸片采用逻辑制程，而非堆叠存储层所用的DRAM制程，因此HBM4正在直接争夺先进逻辑代工产能。

title.en: DRAM Contract-Price Growth Slows to 13–18% in Q3
title.zh: 第三季度DRAM合约价涨幅放缓至13%至18%

summary.en: DRAM contract prices are forecast to rise 13–18% in the third quarter, a slower increase as PC customers limit purchases to essential refreshes. The moderation suggests that AI-driven memory tightness is still lifting prices, but downstream buyers outside the datacenter are increasingly resisting the pass-through.
summary.zh: 第三季度DRAM合约价格预计上涨13%至18%，涨幅有所放缓，PC客户正将采购限制在必要的换机需求。价格仍受到AI带来的存储紧张支撑，但数据中心以外的下游买家正更明显地抵制成本转嫁。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Samsung Adopts a TSMC-Validated Photonics Test Platform
title.zh: Samsung采用经TSMC验证的光子测试平台

summary.en: Samsung has adopted a photonics test platform that was previously validated by TSMC. Reuse of a qualified test stack can reduce integration friction as foundries and customers move silicon photonics toward higher-volume manufacturing, while also making test compatibility a competitive part of the ecosystem.
summary.zh: Samsung已采用一套此前通过TSMC验证的光子测试平台。随着晶圆代工厂与客户推动硅光子进入更大规模制造，复用已验证的测试体系可降低集成摩擦，也使测试兼容性成为生态竞争的一部分。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Malaysia Weighs Huawei AI Chips Despite a U.S. Warning
title.zh: 面对美国警告，马来西亚仍考虑采用Huawei AI芯片

summary.en: Malaysia is considering Huawei AI chips for an AI project despite a warning from the United States. The decision tests how far U.S. technology controls can shape procurement in third countries and gives Huawei another potential route to build an overseas accelerator footprint.
summary.zh: 尽管受到美国警告，马来西亚仍在考虑为一个AI项目采用Huawei AI芯片。这一选择将检验美国技术管制对第三国采购决策的影响力，也可能为Huawei拓展海外加速器部署提供新路径。

title.en: Belgium Detains a Suspect in Semiconductor-Espionage Case
title.zh: 比利时拘留一名涉嫌半导体间谍活动人员

summary.en: Belgian authorities have detained a dual national on suspicion of semiconductor espionage. The case shows that protection of chip know-how is moving beyond export licensing into criminal enforcement, raising compliance and personnel-security stakes for European semiconductor organizations.
summary.zh: 比利时当局已拘留一名双重国籍人士，其涉嫌从事半导体间谍活动。此案显示芯片技术保护正从出口许可延伸至刑事执法，并提高欧洲半导体机构在合规与人员安全方面的风险。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Broadcom's Third-Quarter Profit Rises on Custom-Chip Demand
title.zh: 定制芯片需求推动Broadcom第三季度利润增长

summary.en: Broadcom reported a sharp rise in third-quarter profit as demand grew for its custom chips. The result reinforces the shift toward hyperscaler-designed accelerators and interconnect silicon, where Broadcom supplies design expertise and networking components alongside the dominant merchant-GPU market.
summary.zh: 随着定制芯片需求增长，Broadcom第三季度利润大幅上升。该业绩进一步印证超大规模云厂商正转向自研加速器与互连芯片；Broadcom在主流商用GPU市场之外提供定制设计能力和网络组件。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Moves Down the Stack
theme.zh: 推理效率沿技术栈持续下沉

dek.en: This week's papers compress context, KV cache, weights, and even neural firing while reusing highly tuned GPU primitives. Reliability work also exposes silent corruption paths in radiation-exposed accelerators and quantum-software postprocessing.
dek.zh: 本周论文从上下文、KV cache、权重乃至神经元放电等层面压缩推理成本，同时复用高度优化的GPU原语。可靠性研究还揭示了受辐射加速器与量子软件后处理中的静默错误路径。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: Proton Irradiation of an Open-Source ML Accelerator
title.zh: 开源机器学习加速器的质子辐照表征

papers.authors: S. Memon, R. Graczyk, J. Swakoń, et al.

summary.en: A Tensil neural-network accelerator on a Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC was exposed to 20–58 MeV protons at a monitored fluence of 4.29 × 10^10 p/cm² while running ResNet-20 inference. The test recorded seven workload interruptions and two silent output-corruption events, including 39 consecutive invalid classifications without a kernel, memory, or power anomaly. It is a system-level baseline for an unmitigated implementation, not yet evidence that a particular mitigation will work in flight.
summary.zh: 研究将部署在Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC上的Tensil神经网络加速器置于20–58 MeV质子辐照下，并在运行ResNet-20推理时累计监测到4.29 × 10^10 p/cm²的注量。测试出现7次工作负载中断和2次静默输出损坏，其中一次连续39个输入产生无效分类，但内核日志、有限内存测试和功耗采样均未报错。这是未加固实现的系统级基线，尚不能证明某项缓解措施能在太空任务中奏效。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Large Language Models with At Most One Spike per Neuron
title.zh: 每个神经元至多放电一次的大语言模型

papers.authors: Z. Zhao, P. Omidi, A. Jafari, et al.

summary.en: A reference-based time-to-first-spike scheme maps embeddings, normalization, attention operations, and dropout into an end-to-end spiking LLM with at most one spike per neuron. The work scales the approach to 1.5 billion parameters and matches conventional neural networks on several language-understanding and common-sense tasks, but language-modeling perplexity still trails. Energy gains are estimated from spike activity rather than measured on dedicated neuromorphic silicon.
summary.zh: 研究采用基于参考值的首脉冲时间编码，将嵌入、归一化、注意力运算和dropout映射到端到端脉冲LLM中，使每个神经元至多放电一次。该方法扩展到15亿参数，并在若干语言理解与常识任务上达到传统神经网络相近表现，但语言建模困惑度仍有差距。能耗收益来自脉冲活动估算，而非专用神经形态芯片的实测结果。

title.en: Best-Matching-Unit Search Reaches the GPU L2 Bandwidth Roof
title.zh: 最佳匹配单元搜索触及GPU L2带宽上限

summary.en: A SparseBin best-matching-unit kernel for self-organizing maps improves 5.6–10.1× over its earlier configuration and reaches roughly 385× the older CUDA implementation used in prior MEDLINE atlases. The comparison also tunes the cuSPARSE baseline, which becomes 2–3× faster, while the new kernel reaches 77% of peak L2 bandwidth. The result is specific to this search kernel and workload family, but the symmetric tuning makes the speedup more credible than an untuned-baseline comparison.
summary.zh: 面向自组织映射的SparseBin最佳匹配单元内核，相比早期配置提速5.6–10.1倍，并达到此前MEDLINE图谱所用旧CUDA实现约385倍的速度。研究同时优化cuSPARSE基线，使其提速2–3倍；新内核则达到峰值L2带宽的77%。结果仅针对该搜索内核及其工作负载族，但对双方进行对称优化，使性能对比比使用未调优基线更可信。

title.en: Structured Pruning and Bit-Packed Quantization for Microcontrollers
title.zh: 面向微控制器的结构化剪枝与位打包量化

papers.authors: O. M. Busoye, T. M. Busoye, E. Eigbe

summary.en: Deep Microcompression combines structured pruning, quantization-aware training, and fixed-length bit packing to compress LeNet-5 weights by 55.8× while retaining 98.77% accuracy. On an RP2040 it cuts binary size by 3× versus TensorFlow Lite, and it fits a standard CNN onto an ATmega328P with only 2 KB of SRAM. The evidence is limited to a small, mature vision model, so scaling to modern networks remains unproven.
summary.zh: Deep Microcompression结合结构化剪枝、量化感知训练与定长位打包，在保持LeNet-5准确率98.77%的同时实现55.8倍权重压缩。它在RP2040上的二进制体积比TensorFlow Lite缩小3倍，并将标准CNN部署到仅有2 KB SRAM的ATmega328P上。现有证据仅覆盖规模较小且成熟的视觉模型，能否扩展到现代网络尚未得到验证。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 硬件相关AI研究

title.en: Two-Stage Soft Context Compression for RAG
title.zh: 面向RAG的两阶段软上下文压缩

papers.authors: S. Guo, S. Zhang, Z. Ren

summary.en: DEX-Comp first distills correct answers from an uncompressed RAG system, then applies reinforcement learning only to queries that baseline misses. Across five open-domain QA benchmarks and retrieval depths from top-5 to top-30, it compresses context by 16× and reports 4–24× faster inference with performance comparable to or better than the uncompressed baseline. The gains are benchmark results from a preprint and still need validation under production retrieval distributions.
summary.zh: DEX-Comp先从未压缩RAG系统的正确答案中蒸馏，再仅针对基线答错的问题进行强化学习。它在5个开放域问答基准以及top-5至top-30检索深度下，将上下文压缩16倍，并报告4–24倍推理加速，效果与未压缩基线相当或更好。这些收益来自预印本的基准测试，仍需在生产环境的检索分布下验证。

title.en: Beacon Queries Preserve Long-Range KV-Cache Context
title.zh: Beacon查询保留KV cache中的远程上下文

papers.authors: J. Kim, M. Kim, K. Shim, et al.

summary.en: BeaconKV targets long reasoning traces where later tokens revisit plans and evidence far back in the sequence, breaking eviction policies based mainly on recent queries. It clusters these thought-revisiting queries and keeps compact beacon representatives to select KV entries without retaining the full query history. The method is training-free and evaluated across four open-source reasoning models, though the available preprint abstract does not expose enough detail to judge hardware-level throughput gains.
summary.zh: BeaconKV针对长推理轨迹中后续token重新访问早期计划与证据的现象，这会使主要依赖近期查询的淘汰策略失效。该方法对这类“思路回访”查询进行聚类，并保留紧凑的Beacon代表，以便在不保存完整查询历史的情况下选择KV条目。它无需训练，并在4个开源推理模型上评估，但现有预印本摘要未提供足够细节来判断硬件层面的吞吐提升。

title.en: Fast Gaussian Sums Reuse Flash Attention Kernels
title.zh: 快速高斯求和复用Flash Attention内核

summary.en: Two small input augmentations transform normalized softmax reduction into Gaussian kernel sums with arbitrary signed weights, allowing existing Flash Attention code to execute the operation. For feature dimension D > 8 in fp16, the approach beats compiled PyTorch and PyKeOps kernels in speed, memory overhead, and accuracy while retaining linear memory scaling. The result is attractive because it inherits mature GPU optimization, but its advantage depends on dimension, precision, and the available Flash Attention implementation.
summary.zh: 研究通过两项小型输入扩展，将归一化softmax归约转化为支持任意有符号权重的高斯核求和，从而可直接使用现有Flash Attention代码执行。对于fp16且特征维度D > 8的任务，该方法在速度、内存开销与精度上超过编译后的PyTorch和PyKeOps内核，同时保持线性内存扩展。其优势在于继承成熟的GPU优化，但收益取决于维度、精度和可用的Flash Attention实现。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Postprocessing Data Loss Distorts Quantum Neural Networks
title.zh: 后处理数据丢失扭曲量子神经网络结果

papers.authors: S. V. Panambalom, E. Altamura, N. Chancellor, et al.

summary.en: A Qiskit SamplerQNN postprocessing assumption discards 85–99.6% of valid measurement shots when hardware bit strings span more than 100 physical qubits. On identical raw measurements, the resulting inference accuracy falls from 0.94 to 0.39, while the training-loss signal shrinks by 22–27× without an API warning. Tests on two IBM backends show that classical plumbing can silently dominate quantum-model quality, although this remains a case study of one software path.
summary.zh: Qiskit SamplerQNN后处理中的一项假设，在硬件位串跨越100多个物理量子比特时会丢弃85%至99.6%的有效测量shots。对同一组原始测量数据，推理准确率因此从0.94降至0.39，训练损失信号则缩小22–27倍，且API没有发出警告。两台IBM后端上的测试表明，经典软件链路可能静默地主导量子模型质量，但这仍只是针对一条软件路径的案例研究。
